title: Senior Associate - HR Implementation
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate \- HR Implementation, you will play a pivotal role in delivering HR transformation and technology implementation projects for clients, focusing on HRIS implementations, process design, and data validation. Within our Workforce Consulting practice, you will specialize in providing strategic consulting services to help organizations optimize their workforce and talent management strategies. You will work closely with clients to analyze workforce trends, develop workforce planning strategies, and design talent acquisition, development, and retention programs to align with business objectives and drive organizational success.
   

  

 As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and manage assigned workstreams, developing deliverables within client service engagements. You will build meaningful client connections, anticipate needs, and embrace increased ambiguity. Your role will involve guiding and mentoring others, maintaining professional and technical standards, and using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will support HR implementation and transformation projects, facilitating client sessions to gather HR requirements and document processes. You will also assist with HR data migration activities, system testing, and integration\-related coordination, confirming project delivery aligns with client expectations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Supporting HR transformation and technology implementation projects, including HRIS implementations, process design, and data validation
* Leading assigned workstream activities, collaborating with Managers to meet project expectations
* Facilitating client sessions to gather HR requirements and align system design with client needs
* Documenting HR processes, workflows, and operational requirements for clarity and consistency
* Translating HR process requirements into configuration inputs and testing scenarios
* Assisting with HR data migration, including data mapping, validation, and reconciliation
* Coordinating integration efforts between HRIS, payroll, benefits, and other platforms
* Preparing client\-facing documentation, such as status updates and process documentation
* Tracking project status, risks, and issues, escalating concerns as needed
* Supporting HR service delivery design, including shared services processes and case management workflows
* Assisting with change readiness activities, including training documentation and stakeholder communications
* Supporting HR reporting and analytics by documenting report needs and validating workforce data
* Identifying HR process gaps and opportunities for system\-enabled improvements
* Maintaining project documentation in line with governance and compliance standards
* Coaching junior team members on HR processes and client engagement expectations


 What You Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or a related field
* 4\-8 years of progressive experience in HR transformation, HR operations, HRIS implementation, workforce consulting, shared services, outsourcing, or related project delivery.
* Hands\-on experience supporting HR process design, HRIS implementations, system configuration, testing, data migration, or HR transformation projects.
* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 4 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required


 What Sets You Apart
   

  

* End\-to\-end HR implementation exposure, including discovery, requirements, process design, configuration support, testing, cutover, go\-live, and hypercare.
* Experience supporting Core HR, HR operations, employee lifecycle, HR shared services, case management, or HR service delivery transformation.
* Excelling in HR implementation with enterprise HRIS platforms
* Demonstrating end\-to\-end HR implementation exposure
* Facilitating client\-facing meetings with limited supervision
* Familiarity with workflow design and HR data governance
* Possessing strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Interpreting HR policies and system outputs accurately
* Mentoring junior team members effectively

 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Talent Management Specialist
description:
**Talent Management Specialist** 




**Function:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Reports To:** 
 Head – HR CoE
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, India
 



**Experience:** 
 7–10 years
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 Drive NIIT’s Talent Management agenda as part of Building NIIT 2\.0, with focus on Performance Management, Talent Reviews, Succession Planning, Leadership Development, Internal Mobility and Talent Analytics.
 



 This is a CoE role responsible for designing frameworks, driving enterprise execution, strengthening governance and enabling data\-led talent decisions across businesses.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Performance Management** 



* Drive end\-to\-end execution of the annual performance cycle including goal setting, mid\-year reviews, year\-end assessments, calibration and moderation.
* Strengthen quality of goals, performance differentiation and manager accountability.
* Own PMS governance, timelines, dashboards and compliance.
* Use performance data to identify trends, gaps and required actions.

* Design and drive enterprise talent review processes.
* Assess talent across performance, potential, criticality and readiness.
* Facilitate structured talent discussions with HRBPs and business leaders.
* Track agreed development, movement, retention and succession actions.

* Maintain successor readiness across Ready Now / Ready Soon / Longer\-Term categories.
* Track succession gaps and leadership pipeline strength.
* Support development and movement of identified successor talent.

* Identify priority leadership and manager capability gaps.
* Design interventions around accountability, feedback, decision\-making, talent development and change leadership.
* Link leadership development to talent and succession outcomes.
* Track effectiveness and business application of interventions.



**5\. Internal Mobility** 



* Build frameworks to strengthen internal movement and career progression.
* Connect talent reviews, succession and workforce requirements to internal opportunities.
* Improve visibility of internal talent across functions and businesses.
* Partner with HRBPs and Talent Acquisition to improve internal fill where relevant.



**6\. Talent Analytics** 



* Build and manage dashboards covering performance, talent, succession, mobility and leadership pipeline.
* Identify talent risks, capability gaps and emerging trends.
* Translate data into clear insights for leadership decision\-making.
* Strengthen data quality and governance across Talent Management processes.



**7\. Culture \& NIIT 2\.0** 



* Embed expected leadership and performance behaviours into Talent Management processes.
* Support consistent talent practices across businesses.
* Enable stronger collaboration, accountability and development as part of the
 **One NIIT** 
 agenda.



**8\. Governance \& Execution** 



* Own the annual Talent Management calendar and operating rhythm.
* Establish clear templates, governance and review mechanisms.
* Drive periodic talent reviews and leadership dashboards.
* Track closure of agreed actions across performance, succession and talent development.



**Experience** 



* 7 – 10 years of HR experience with strong depth in Talent Management / Performance / Succession / OD / Leadership Development.
* Experience designing and driving enterprise Talent Management processes.
* Strong exposure to senior leadership talent reviews and succession discussions.
* Experience in organisations undergoing growth, integration or transformation preferred.
* Exposure to HR technology and Talent Management systems preferred.



  





**Core Capabilities** 



* Talent Management framework design
* Performance Management
* Succession Planning
* Talent Reviews
* Leadership Development
* Talent Analytics
* Stakeholder Management
* Project \& Governance Discipline
* Business Acumen
* Change Management

title: Total Rewards Market Partnership Expert
description:

 We are looking for an experienced Total Rewards professional to join our Regional Rewards Centre of Competence as a GPPT and Market Partnership Expert.
   

  

 In this specialist role, you will provide strategic guidance and functional expertise across multiple markets, supporting the effective delivery of Total Rewards programmes, policies and processes. You will act as a trusted partner to market Total Rewards teams and senior stakeholders, providing advice on compensation strategy, annual reward processes, market benchmarking, job evaluation, pay structures and rewards governance.

* Promote the simplification and standardisation of position evaluation processes across markets while maintaining high levels of data quality.
* Lead or coordinate regional and global Total Rewards projects, ensuring effective market coverage and delivery within agreed timelines.
* Support the transition of selected Rewards activities to shared service teams, ensuring a seamless process and positive employee experience throughout the transition and hypercare period.
* Ensure compliance with compensation policies and governance requirements, including appropriate documentation and approval of key reward decisions.
* Develop and deliver Total Rewards training programmes for HR and Rewards communities.
* Coach and mentor Total Rewards colleagues, particularly new team members, and contribute to capability\-building initiatives across the function.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* A university degree or an equivalent qualification.
* At least five years of Human Resources experience gained within a large organisation with progressive people practices and/or an HR consulting environment.
* Strong experience in compensation, rewards, employee cost management or workforce budgeting.
* Practical knowledge of job analysis and job evaluation methodologies, such as IPE or an equivalent methodology.
* Experience in external market benchmarking, compensation analysis, market pricing and salary structure design.
* Strong understanding of annual compensation processes, including salary reviews, incentive programmes and long\-term incentive arrangements.
* Experience in developing and using HR metrics, KPIs and data\-driven insights.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to analyse complex datasets and translate findings into practical compensation recommendations.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder\-management skills.
* The ability to influence without formal authority and build credible professional relationships across functions and geographies.
* Strong project\-management, organisational and time\-management capabilities.
* The ability to work effectively under pressure and manage demanding deadlines.
* A collaborative mindset and the ability to contribute effectively within multifunctional and international teams.


**Additional Experience That Would Be An Advantage**
* Experience working in the FMCG sector.
* Experience using SAP HR or similar HR systems.
* Knowledge of local employment law and labour regulations.
* A professional qualification in remuneration or compensation methodologies.
* Experience with compensation benchmarking tools and salary survey platforms, including Mercer tools or equivalent solutions.
* Exposure to international transfer management, including mobility packages, relocation, taxation and immigration considerations.


**Key Stakeholders**
 You will collaborate with market and regional Total Rewards teams, HR leaders, Finance, IT, corporate Rewards teams, shared service organisations and other internal stakeholders. You will also engage with salary survey providers, HR consultancies, compensation forums and external professional networks.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 This is an opportunity to apply your Total Rewards expertise in a highly collaborative and international environment. You will influence compensation strategy across multiple markets, contribute to regional and global Rewards initiatives, and help strengthen the capabilities of Total Rewards teams across the organisation.
   

  

**Apply Now**

title: Senior Manager - HR Transformation
description:
**Senior Manager \- People Excellence (HR Transformation)** 




  





 Location \- Gurgaon
 



  





**About Urban Company** 




 Urban Company is a tech\-enabled home services marketplace. Customers use our platform to book services, such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, which are delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high quality, standardized and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



  





**About the Role \& Team** 




 People Excellence runs the operating backbone of People Success, for a full time workforce and a large contractual workforce across India and international markets.
 



 This is the transformation seat in that team. As UC scales, how the People function plans, measures and delivers has to be rebuilt around systems, automation and AI rather than manual effort. Owning that shift is the job. You will run it as a portfolio of projects: rebuilding how the company plans manpower and cost, automating work that today takes days, putting real analytics behind People decisions, redesigning core employee processes, and preparing the organisation for regulatory change. Each one is yours from diagnosis through design to adoption.
 



 The role reports to the Director, People Excellence, and works closely with the CHRO and business leadership.
 



  





**Why this role is different** 




 Real problems, owned end to end, with high impact and visibility. You pick what matters, build the case, and see it through to adoption.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 



* Own the transformation roadmap for People Excellence: diagnose where the function loses time, accuracy or credibility, build the business case, and sequence the work by impact
* Lead the automation and AI charter end to end, from problem definition and solution design through build with internal tech teams or vendors to adoption on the ground
* Redesign core People processes around the experience they should deliver rather than the way they currently happen, and drive the change management that makes a redesign stick
* Own People analytics: the dashboards, metric definitions and data that leadership actually makes decisions on
* Drive workforce and cost planning: the annual AOP, monthly budget versus actual analysis, and the manpower models behind both
* Run the mid\-year and annual performance management cycles for the organisation, working with People Success leadership
* Lead regulatory change readiness, starting with the new labour codes, translating legislation into process alongside consultants and internal legal
* Do the analysis yourself. This is a hands\-on role: you will pull the data, build the model and write the recommendation rather than briefing someone else to
* Own data accuracy across People systems, defining the controls that make HR data trustworthy for the People Success partners who rely on it day to day, and for Finance, leadership and auditors



  





**What we'll need:** 



* MBA with 4\-5 years of experience in HR transformation, HR operations, project management, analytics or automation
* Ownership of cross\-functional projects end to end, with outcomes you can point to
* Strong problem solving: able to break an open\-ended problem down, and comfortable working with data to get to the answer
* Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgement to choose what matters when everything looks urgent
* Ability to influence without authority, across Finance, Tech, Legal and business teams
* Hands on with Microsoft Excel and Google suite; experience with HRMS platforms (Darwinbox a plus) and a real appetite for applying AI tooling to operational problems
* Strong written and verbal communication, and the presence to hold a room with senior stakeholders
* Super organized yet agile to adapt to UC's way of working



  





**Folks you will work with:** 




 We understand that the people you work with and learn from is the single most important determinant of how much you enjoy working at a place. In fact, this defines the culture in many ways. Here is a list of UC folks you can expect to work with and collaborate with:
 


* Utkarsh Bindal, VP: Ex. Airtel, Bira91, MDI
* Chetna Wadhwa, Director: Ex. Rivigo, MDI, DCE



  





**What can you expect:** 



* A great work environment with massive ownership and growth opportunities \- we hire folks for a career opportunity, not just the role.
* Energy and hustle of a startup with processes and depth of a big organization
* Expect to work with people you can learn from and are invested in your growth

Growth Enablement is a strategic business operations function that helps accelerate business growth through operational excellence, workforce strategy, financial governance, performance reporting, transformation initiatives, and executive stakeholder support. As an Associate Director, you will play a key leadership role in driving large\-scale business priorities, enabling decision\-making, and shaping operational strategies that support organizational growth and profitability.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and execute strategic business initiatives aligned with organizational growth objectives.
* Partner with senior leadership to drive operational excellence, business transformation, and performance improvement programs.
* Develop and oversee workforce planning, capacity management, and talent strategies.
* Drive financial governance, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance reporting.
* Lead cross\-functional programs involving multiple stakeholders across geographies and business functions.
* Establish governance frameworks, metrics, and executive dashboards to support informed decision\-making.
* Identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities while driving mitigation plans and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Manage senior stakeholder relationships and provide strategic recommendations to leadership teams.
* Drive automation, process optimization, and productivity improvement initiatives.
* Lead, coach, and mentor high\-performing teams to deliver business outcomes and organizational priorities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Extensive experience in business operations, strategy, program management, consulting, or transformation.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale cross\-functional initiatives and stakeholder management.
* Strong understanding of financial management, budgeting, forecasting, and business planning.
* Experience in executive reporting, governance, and performance management.
* Demonstrated leadership capability with experience managing teams and developing talent.


**Preferred Skills**
* Strategic thinking and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong executive communication and presentation skills.
* Experience driving organizational transformation and change management initiatives.
* Advanced analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to influence senior leaders and drive outcomes in a matrixed environment.
* Expertise in business planning, operational governance, and performance optimization.


 Professional Attributes
   

  

* Strong leadership presence and executive maturity.
* Excellent relationship\-building and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage ambiguity and drive results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Collaborative mindset with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement.
* High level of accountability, ownership, and business acumen.

title: Human Resources Manager

* Strong focus on

**Role Overview – What You’ll Own** 




 You will be the only

 Your job is to make sure:
 


* The

* The 
 **right culture**

 You’ll work closely with the

 1\.

title: Head of Talent
description:
This position is with Manifest Global, which also includes trailblazer brands such as Cialfo, Explore, BridgeU, and Kaaiser.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as AI reshapes the industries that keep economies running. Every institution that finds, develops, and places talent, whether for a company, a university system, or a country, is being rebuilt around that shift right now. Most of them are rebuilding slowly, with the same processes they used a decade ago and AI bolted on at the edges.
   

  

 Manifest doesn't have that luxury, and doesn't want it. The business is built on the premise that talent mobility, at civilisational scale, needs an AI\-native operating system, not a faster version of the old one. That premise applies as much to how Manifest builds its own team as it does to the students, schools, and universities it serves. A company that tells the world it is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity cannot run its own Talent function on spreadsheets and instinct, and cannot treat workforce planning as an afterthought to the business plan rather than the thing that makes the business plan achievable.
   

  

 This role owns Talent at Manifest globally, in full: the hiring engine, the employee experience, the leadership bench across every business unit, the workforce plan that keeps the org ahead of the business rather than reacting to it, and the AI\-powered infrastructure that ties all of it together. You are the person who translates talent into the language the executive team and the board already use for revenue and margin: capacity, capability, retention, and risk.
   

  

 You own building Talent into the kind of high\-performing, self\-sustaining organisation that Manifest expects every function to become, and proving that Talent can lead by example rather than trail behind.
   

  

**What Makes This Role Different**
 Most talent leadership roles inherit a function built for a single business, in a single market, with a stable headcount. This one spans five brands, multiple geographies, and a growth model built substantially through acquisition, which means the workforce plan, the leadership bench, and the AI infrastructure you build all have to absorb new companies and new people on short notice, repeatedly, without losing coherence. That is a materially harder systems and leadership problem than most "Head of Talent" titles are asked to solve, and it is why the Manifest ecosystem, the ability to move people, standards, and leadership talent across five connected businesses, is the advantage no standalone competitor for this hire can offer you.
   

  

 The timing is specific. Manifest is scaling its reach across more than 150 countries at a moment when the broader overseas education industry is contracting and Manifest is growing. Building the workforce plan, the leadership pipeline, and the AI\-native infrastructure now, while the function is still being shaped rather than fixed in place, is a materially different opportunity than doing it later, after the patterns have hardened.
   

  

**Why This Is Worth Your Next Decade**
 Most people who lead Talent at this level inherit an org chart and a reporting calendar and are asked to run both well. You are being asked to decide what the org chart should be, build the workforce plan that keeps pace with a business growing across borders, and prove that a talent function can operate with the same rigor, and the same voice at the table, as finance or product. Companies that get this right in the next five years will define how the next generation of global companies build their people functions, and how talent leadership earns a genuine seat in the room rather than an invitation to it. You would be one of the people who decided what that looks like, for Manifest and for the industry watching how Manifest does it.
   

  

**What You Own**
**Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Engine**
* Own the hiring strategy and standard across every brand, every geography, and every level, from individual contributor to executive search
* Build a sourcing, screening, and closing engine that runs on AI\-native tooling as the default, not the exception
* Set the bar for what a great hire looks like at Manifest, and hold every part of the function accountable to it


**Talent Operations And The Employee Experience**
* Own the full employee lifecycle globally: onboarding, offboarding, compliance, compensation coordination, people analytics, and workplace support
* Build a consistent standard of experience regardless of brand, geography, or manager
* Ensure Manifest's multi\-jurisdiction footprint runs with the same rigor a business its size requires


**High\-Performing Teams, Leadership Development, and Succession**
* Build and coach a Business Partnering team embedded in every business unit, operating as strategic peers to the leaders they support, not a support function
* Own leadership pipeline and succession coverage across the group, so every critical role has a named path to readiness rather than a gap discovered under pressure
* Set the standard for what a high\-performing team looks like at Manifest, and build the manager capability that makes that standard repeatable rather than dependent on any one leader


**Strategic Workforce Planning and Business Alignment**
* Own the workforce plan that translates business goals into people requirements, capacity, capability, and retention, the same way a financial plan translates strategy into numbers
* Build the forecasting discipline that keeps hiring, mobility, and org design ahead of the business plan rather than reacting to it
* Own Talent's presence in quarterly business reviews and board reporting, making the workforce as measurable and as credible as revenue


**Talent AI and Infrastructure**
* Build a dedicated capability that makes Talent AI\-native from the ground up: sourcing, screening, onboarding, workforce analytics, and decision support, all running on AI rather than layered with it afterward
* Own the systems architecture that connects every part of Talent into one coherent function instead of several
* Bring the same technical standard to Talent that Manifest brings to its own products


**Executive Partnership and Talent Thought Leadership**
* Be the strategic talent voice at the table when the CEO, COO, and business unit leaders are shaping direction, including on acquisitions from the earliest stage
* Represent Manifest's point of view on talent and AI\-native people practices externally, as part of how the company is known in its markets, not just how it hires into them
* Set the intellectual agenda inside Manifest for how leaders think about their people, so talent becomes a discipline every executive is fluent in, not a function they delegate to


**What Success Looks Like**
 The markers below reflect where Talent is today. We will calibrate the specifics once you are in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
   

  

 In the first months, you have formed a clear, specific point of view on how the workforce plan should connect to the business plan, on where the leadership bench is strong and where it needs building, and on what the AI\-native infrastructure underneath all of it needs to look like. You have earned real credibility with business unit leaders and with the executive team as someone who understands their commercial reality, not just their headcount requests.
   

  

 By mid\-period, Talent runs measurably differently: the workforce plan is a standing input to business planning rather than a reaction to it, succession coverage exists for every critical role, and the function is visibly AI\-native in how it sources, hires, and supports people across every brand. Talent's reporting to the executive team and the board is as credible and as data\-driven as finance's.
   

  

 In the long term, you have built a Talent function, and a leadership bench beneath you, that other companies point to as a model, and that Manifest's own executive team points to as proof that talent strategy and business strategy are the same conversation.
   

  

 The specifics will be calibrated once you are in the role. The direction won't change.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 You have built and led talent functions at real scale before, across more than one country and more than one business line, because the coordination problem here is not theoretical. You think about Talent the way a strong general manager thinks about a business: as a set of interconnected systems and bets, workforce planning, leadership development, hiring, infrastructure, not a collection of HR processes running in parallel.
   

  

 You have built high\-performing teams before, and you know the difference between a team that performs because of one strong leader and a team that performs because the systems, the bench, and the standards make it repeatable. You are fluent in workforce planning as a genuine discipline: translating a business plan into a people plan, forecasting capacity and capability gaps before they become urgent, and making the case for headcount and investment in terms the executive team finds credible.
   

  

 You are genuinely fluent in how AI changes talent work, not as a talking point but as a practitioner, and you know the difference between AI as a feature bolted onto an old process and AI as the foundation a process is rebuilt around.
   

  

 You have a real point of view on talent and you are comfortable being the voice that carries it, inside the executive team and in how the company is known externally. You have led leaders, not just individual contributors, and you hold them to a standard that is honest rather than diplomatic, while still being the kind of leader they would choose to work for again.
   

  

 Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building, an AI\-native operating system for global talent mobility, and your first reaction was not "that's an ambitious mission statement," it was "I know exactly how to build the talent function, and the team, that proves it's true." That's the person this role is for.
   

  

**Why Manifest**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for how human talent finds opportunity across borders, an AI\-native operating system that identifies talent, develops it, and places it at civilisational scale. Through Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners), Manifest connects students, schools, universities, and employers across more than 150 countries. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. By 2030, the world will need 85 million more skilled workers than it has today, and 375 million people will need to reskill as industries are reshaped by AI. Manifest is backed by $91M from Tiger Global, Square Peg Capital, Susquehanna Asia Venture Capital, and others. Still early.
   

  

 For this role specifically: Manifest sells the world an AI\-native way of moving talent across borders. Talent, the function, is where that standard either becomes real inside the company, in the teams it builds and the workforce plan it runs, or stays a claim on a careers page. This role decides which one it is.
   

  

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 150\+ countries.

title: People Systems Manager
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 




 We are seeking a proactive and experienced People Systems Program Manager to join our dynamic People Team. This role is crucial for supporting our People systems and enhancements and requires 5 – 7 years of hand\-on experience with large HCM platforms and other HR systems. As a self\-starter, you will be responsible for both the daily support and the strategic improvement of our People Team technology, acting as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to drive successful outcomes.
 

  
 




**Your Impact**

  
 





 As the People Systems Program Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and optimizing our People systems and processes. Your work will directly contribute to the successful delivery of People systems initiatives, improve user experience, and ensure our People platforms evolve to meet business needs. You will have the opportunity to make a significant impact by transforming business requirements into effective, scalable solutions.
 

  
 




**Key Responsibilities**

  
 



* Own and deliver the cross\-functional People systems roadmap, directly enabling the success of the People and IT teams. Design and manage a centralized intake and prioritization process for all system enhancement requests, owning this significant process within the People team's project structure.


* Proactively identify and solve People systems and data problems before they impact other teams. Use your deep expertise in HR processes and systems to translate vague requirements into practical, innovative solutions and clear functional specifications for the configuration team.


* Partner with People Team stakeholders to gather requirements for new and existing systems enhancements and reports, while ensuring People data integrity and governance.


* Coordinate and support implementation and management of our People systems and related internal tools.


* Train end users and create collateral to target audiences


* Support and maintain compliance activities by ensuring HR data, system configurations, and business processes align with internal controls and regulatory requirements.


* Manage and support release cycles, including analyzing new features and advising People Team leaders and functional SMEs on potential benefits and considerations.



**Your Qualifications**

  
 



* 5\-7 years of experience in an HRIS, People technology, or related Program Management role.


* Demonstrated ability to own and deliver cross\-functional projects from start to finish, influencing peers and stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.


* Sought out for your ability to resolve ambiguity and proactively identify and solve complex problems before they escalate.


* Experience acting as an autonomous owner of project deliverables and mentoring junior team members.


* Strong experience with a major HCM platform and a deep understanding of core HR business processes.


* Proven ability to translate business needs into functional requirements and system specifications.


* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted and influential voice in planning discussions.


* Must be able to work flexible hours to ensure overlap with the U.S. Eastern time zone.



**Desired Skills and Attributes**

  
 



* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills.


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.


* A collaborative team player with a passion for learning and continuous improvement.



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
**Company Description** 
 Goertrip is a travel technology platform focused on seamless flight bookings and curated travel experiences for both individual travelers and travel agents. The company offers significant discounts, flexible schemes, and rewards, enabling agents to design hassle\-free itineraries for their clients. Goertrip’s “book now, pay later” options, extensive fixed departure inventory, and flexi\-pay features help users access some of the lowest available fares. In addition, the platform provides premium luxury homestays and unique refund fare challenges to enhance the overall travel experience. Applicants join a fast\-growing, customer\-centric organization dedicated to making flying more accessible and convenient.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Human Resources Specialist is a full\-time, on\-site role based in New Delhi. This role is responsible for supporting end\-to\-end HR operations, including recruitment coordination, onboarding, employee records management, and HR documentation. The specialist will assist in implementing HR policies, administering employee benefits, and addressing routine employee queries in a timely and confidential manner. Day\-to\-day tasks include maintaining HR information systems, supporting performance and attendance tracking, and ensuring compliance with internal procedures and applicable regulations. The role also collaborates with managers to support employee engagement initiatives, training programs, and a positive, inclusive work environment.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong foundation in Human Resources (HR) and HR Management, with experience handling core HR operations.
* Ability to develop, interpret, and apply HR Policies while supporting Personnel Management activities.
* Knowledge of Employee Benefits administration and related compliance requirements.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Proficiency with HRIS tools and basic MS Office applications.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain high ethical standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage.
* Prior experience in a fast\-paced corporate or travel/technology environment is beneficial.

title: Associate - People Success (AI Analyst)
description:
**Job Role: Associate \- People Success (AI Analyst)** 




  





**About the role:** 
 We are throwing out the traditional HR playbook. We don't need administrators; we need builders, system thinkers, and problem solvers.
 



  





 As a People Success Associate (AI Native), you won't be doing routine coordination or organizing meaningless fun activities. You will work directly with the Head of HR on high\-leverage strategic projects, core process automations, and building systems that enable a high\-performing organization. If you view this world as a tech product, this role is for you. Think of it as a Founder's Office/AI Analyst role in the HR function.
 



  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* AI\-Native \& Tech\-First Mindset: You don't just use ChatGPT for writing emails. You know how to build workflows, leverage API tools, or vibe\-code custom internal scripts/apps.
* High Emotional Intelligence (EQ): You understand human dynamics, motivations, and organizational friction deeply.
* Analytical Muscle: You think in logic trees, metrics, and systems, not just gut feelings.
* Relentless Problem\-Solving: You get genuine joy out of fixing broken processes and making teams wildly efficient.



  





**You should not apply if you:** 



* Struggle with ownership and require constant supervision to drive tasks
* Are uncomfortable working with data, numbers, or analytical problem\-solving
* Are not willing to collaborate with cross\-functional teams



  





**Skills Required:** 
 AI Native, Product Manager mindset, High EQ
 



  





**What will you do?** 




  




* **Process Automation:** 
 Audit existing HR workflows (onboarding, performance loops, internal communications) and automate them using no\-code, low\-code, or vibe coding tools.
* **People Analytics:** 
 Dive into team metrics, attrition signals, and performance data to extract actionable insights\- not just passive reports.

title: People & Culture Leader
description:
**Mission Brief: Lead the Transformation of Lenskart's People Organization** 




 This is a high\-impact leadership role focused on building and operationalizing a world\-class, AI\-first People Platform for Lenskart. You will be the architect responsible for transforming how Lenskart manages its most valuable asset its tens of thousands of employees across retail and corporate functions moving us from static HR processes and annual review cycles to a real\-time, data\-driven organization and talent engine.
 



 Your mission is to bridge the gap between cutting\-edge people technology and Lenskart's next decade of hypergrowth. You will define and deliver the system that ensures we have the right talent, in the right role, at the right moment across a 3000\+ store retail network and a fast\-scaling technology organization spanning India, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Japan maximizing organizational performance and employee experience globally.
 



  





**Core Mandate: Platform Development \& Organizational Transformation** 




  





**1 Internal People Platform Creation (The Builder's Focus)** 



* **Platform Visionary:** 
 Own the strategic vision, architecture, and deployment of Lenskart's proprietary AI/ML\-based people platform (the Organization Decision Engine). This includes key modules for predictive attrition sensing, dynamic workforce planning, real\-time span\-of\-control optimization, and system\-driven succession signals.
* **Technical Partnership:** 
 Act as the primary business lead, translating complex organizational and talent requirements into actionable technical specifications for Data Science, People Analytics, and Engineering teams.
* **Systems Design Ownership:** 
 Lead the design and configuration of all core people\-decisioning algorithms and logic, ensuring they maximize retention and internal mobility while intelligently navigating the very different dynamics of a frontline\-retail workforce and a fast\-scaling corporate/tech organization.



  





**2 Strategic Talent \& Culture Growth (The Business Focus)** 



* **P\&L Impact:** 
 Directly influence workforce cost performance by minimizing attrition\-driven hiring costs and maximizing productivity and capability across our extensive network of stores and corporate functions.
* **Capability Excellence:** 
 Implement and manage advanced models to continuously improve leadership\-pipeline strength and capability coverage across thousands of roles, driving measurable improvements in succession readiness and organizational resilience.
* **Strategic Workforce Planning:** 
 Define the logic and processes for transitioning reactive headcount requests into strategic workforce planning, ensuring system\-generated hiring signals and organization design decisions are dynamically linked to real\-time business performance and financial goals.



  





**3 Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Adoption** 



* **Change Agent:** 
 Lead the cultural and technical adoption of the new platform across the organization (Retail Operations, Merchandising, Technology, Finance). Challenge the status quo and enforce a data\-driven, people\-decision\-making culture.
* **New Market Integration:** 
 Design the system's capabilities to seamlessly integrate new market entries and manage the full employee lifecycle across geographies, ensuring rapid scaling and minimal disruption as Lenskart expands into new countries.



  





**The Essentials** 



* **Experience:** 
 15\+ years of progressive leadership experience in HR, Organization Design, or People Analytics, with a strong track record of defining, building, or significantly revamping a core people or workforce platform (internal or external), ideally across multi\-country, frontline\-heavy organizations.
* **Technical Acumen:** 
 Proven experience as a business lead for enterprise HR/people analytics solutions, with a deep, practical understanding of workforce forecasting, organization network analysis, and machine learning applications in attrition and capability planning.



  





**Education:** 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Business, or a highly quantitative field.
 



**The Mindset** 




**Systems \& Product Thinking:** 
 You possess the intellectual curiosity and technical capability to define the architecture of a global people\-operating system. You see the people function as a product that requires continuous development and optimization — not a set of static policies.
 



**Analytical Rigor \& Speed:** 
 You thrive on organizational complexity, transforming ambiguity — competing markets, cultures, and business units — into clear, scalable, and commercially sound people solutions at the pace of a high\-growth company.
 



**Transformational Leadership:** 
 You are a compelling communicator capable of driving strategic change, securing organizational alignment from the Founder\-CEO down to frontline store managers, and mentoring a team of high\-performing HR business partners and people\-analytics talent.

This role is responsible for driving cadence, governance, reporting, and cross\-tower execution to ensure all client\-mandated and internal programs, deliverables, and reporting requirements are met with strong rigor, speed, and quality. The incumbent will operate as a single point of contact (SPOC) for tracking and reporting critical parameters across towers, enabling proactive risk management and executive decision\-making.
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* 18\+ years of experience in Program Management, Chief of Staff roles, or Large\-Scale Operations Governance (BFSI/Insurance preferred).
* Strong experience working directly with senior executives (MD/Senior VP level) in high\-paced environments.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives across distributed teams and geographies. Preferred Certifications
* PMP certification is preferred (or equivalent program management certification). Core Skills / Competencies
* Advanced in analytics, executive reporting, and performance dashboards.
* Strong proficiency in Excel (advanced), PowerPoint (exec storytelling); Power BI is a strong advantage.
* Ability to translate complex data into crisp insights and actions. Program/Project Execution
* Strong program management discipline: planning, milestone tracking, dependency management, RAID governance.
* Ability to drive through influence (without direct authority). Executive Communication
* Excellent written/verbal communication; capability to create C\-suite\-ready narratives.
* High attention to detail, strong stakeholder presence, and structured thinking. Collaboration \& Leadership
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration across towers, functions, and leadership layers.
* Bias for action, ownership mindset, and ability to operate with ambiguity. Roles and Responsibilities: Key Responsibilities 1\) Executive Office Enablement
* Own the Leadership business rhythm: weekly/monthly governance cadence, leadership reviews, QBR preparation, and executive communications.
* Drive meeting excellence: agenda, pre\-reads, action capture, follow\-ups, and closure tracking across stakeholders.
* Prepare executive\-ready materials: leadership decks, performance narratives, client updates, and decision briefs. 2\) Cross\-Tower Program \& Delivery Governance
* Act as the center point across Retirement towers to ensure alignment, execution, and progress against priorities.
* Drive and monitor strategic initiatives, transformation programs, and internal projects end\-to\-end (scope, plan, milestones, dependencies, risks).
* Ensure cross\-functional coordination across Delivery, Quality, Risk \& Compliance, Workforce, Finance, and Technology teams. 3\) Reporting, Analytics \& Performance Management (SPOC)
* Own consolidated reporting across towers: operational metrics, key deliverables, milestones, and executive KPIs.
* Build and maintain analytics\-driven dashboards (Excel/Power BI preferred) to track:
* Client deliverables \& contractual/mandated requirements
* Performance \& productivity metrics
* Risks/issues/actions (RAID), compliance and audit actions
* Transformation benefits and project health
* convert data into insights: highlight trends, early warnings, root causes, and recommended actions. 4\) Stakeholder Management \& Communication
* Serve as single point of contact to coordinate critical asks from leadership and key stakeholders.
* Create strong stakeholder alignment through structured updates, transparent tracking, and timely escalation.
* Ensure clear ownership, RACI, and closure across all open actions and commitments. 5\) Risk, Controls \& Governance (as relevant)
* Maintain rigorous governance discipline to ensure deliverables are audit\-ready and timely.
* Proactively surface key risks, dependencies, and decision points to the MD and leadership team.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Human Resources Executive** 

**Minimalist Hotels \| South Delhi** 




**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
 



**Compensation:** 
 Up to ₹4 LPA
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Full\-time \| On\-site
 


**About Minimalist Hotels** 

 Minimalist Hotels is a series of design\-forward hybrid hotels that blend community\-style living with hotel\-style amenities for young, urban and creative travellers.
 



 Operating
 **10 hotels across India** 
 in Delhi, Varanasi, Goa and Udaipur, Minimalist has welcomed
 **5,00,000\+ guests from 50\+ countries** 
 since 2017\.
 



 Our properties are more than hotels. They bring together accommodation, F\&B, events, retail, art, fashion, workshops and music — creating spaces where travellers, locals and creative communities come together.
 



 With new properties opening soon in
 **Goa and Jaipur** 
 , we are continuing to build a hospitality brand around
 **design, culture, community and great people.** 



**The Role** 

 We are looking for a
 **Human Resources Executive** 
 to join our team in
 **South Delhi** 
 and take ownership of day\-to\-day HR operations for our hotel.
 



 This is a
 **hands\-on, people\-facing role** 
 for someone who enjoys working closely with employees, department heads and hotel leadership.
 



 You will be responsible for ensuring that we have the right people, the right processes and the right culture in place — from hiring and onboarding to employee engagement, performance, documentation and compliance.
 



 You will work closely with the Hotel General Manager and department heads across
 **Front Office, Housekeeping, F\&B, Kitchen, Sales \& other hotel functions.** 



**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning** 
* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for hotel and F\&B positions.
* Coordinate with department heads on manpower requirements and hiring plans.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, local networks and hospitality institutes.
* Conduct initial screening and coordinate interviews.
* Maintain an active talent pipeline for operational roles.


**2\. Joining \& Onboarding** 
* Own the complete employee joining process.
* Ensure timely documentation, background verification and employee records.
* Conduct HR induction and introduce new employees to Minimalist’s culture, policies and values.
* Ensure new employees have a smooth transition into their respective departments.


**3\. HR Operations \& Documentation** 
* Maintain accurate employee files, attendance, leave and HR records.
* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with Finance.
* Track employee confirmations, transfers, promotions, resignations and exits.
* Maintain updated manpower and employee databases.
* Prepare regular HR MIS and reports for hotel leadership.


**4\. Employee Relations** 
* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries and concerns.
* Build strong relationships with hotel staff across departments and shifts.
* Support managers in handling employee issues, conflicts and disciplinary matters.
* Maintain a positive, respectful and inclusive workplace environment.
* Identify employee concerns early and escalate critical matters appropriately.


**5\. Performance \& People Development** 
* Support department heads with performance reviews and employee feedback.
* Track probation confirmations and performance improvement plans.
* Coordinate employee training and development initiatives.
* Help build a culture of accountability, ownership and continuous learning.


**6\. Culture \& Employee Engagement** 
* Bring the
 **Minimalist culture** 
 alive at the property.
* Organise employee engagement activities, celebrations and team initiatives.
* Improve employee communication and participation.
* Help create an environment where people feel valued, heard and motivated.


**7\. Compliance** 
* Ensure adherence to applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain required HR documentation and registers.
* Coordinate with external consultants / management wherever required for statutory compliance.
* Ensure hotel HR practices are aligned with company policies.


**What We’re Looking For** 
* **1–3 years of HR experience** 
 , preferably in hotels, hospitality, restaurants, retail or another service\-oriented business.
* Strong understanding of
 **HR operations, recruitment and employee relations** 
 .
* Comfortable working with frontline employees and large operational teams.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to handle sensitive employee matters with maturity and confidentiality.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic hospitality environment.
* Good working knowledge of
 **MS Excel, Google Workspace and HR systems** 
 .
* A Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration or a related field is preferred.


**Most importantly…** 

 We are looking for someone who is
 **people\-first, energetic, approachable and hands\-on.** 




 Someone who doesn’t want to sit in an HR office all day, but wants to
 **walk the hotel, know the team, understand what’s happening on the ground and solve problems.** 




 At Minimalist, HR is not just about attendance, payroll and paperwork.
 



**It is about building the team that builds the hotel.** 



**Why Join Minimalist?** 
* Work with one of India’s emerging independent hospitality brands.
* Be part of a young, creative and entrepreneurial environment.
* Exposure to multiple functions across
 **hospitality, F\&B, events, culture and community** 
 .
* Opportunity to grow with a rapidly expanding hotel company.
* Work closely with hotel leadership and department heads.
* Be part of a company where
 **people and culture are central to the business.**



**Location:** 
 South Delhi
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time \| On\-site
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years
 



**Compensation:** 
 Up to ₹4 LPA, depending on experience and fit
 


**To Apply** 

 Send your CV along with a brief note on
 **why you would like to work with Minimalist Hotels** 
 .

title: Manager - People Services Operations
description:
**ERM** 
 is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with over 50 years of experience helping organisations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance challenges. We bring together a global community of experts to deliver meaningful impact for our clients and the planet.
   

  

 The
 **Global Delivery Centre** 
 (GDC) in Gurugram is ERM’s global operating backbone. It delivers business enablement services in Finance, HR, IT, and Commercial Operations to ensure ERM’s global business runs seamlessly, efficiently, and consistently.
   

  

 At the GDC, you will:
   

  

* Be part of a hub that ensures ERM’s business continuity worldwide.
* Collaborate with colleagues across geographies to support global operations.
* Drive consistency, compliance, and efficiency in core functions.
* Work with digital, automation, and AI\-enabled tools to optimise how ERM operates.
* Work in shifts where required, depending on the role. As processes mature and automation increases, reliance on shifts will reduce.
* Why this role matters?


 As a
 **People Services Team Lead** 
 , you will support ERM's global delivery by leading the execution of HR operations and employee lifecycle processes while ensuring a consistent, high\-quality service experience for employees and managers globally. You will work within the
 **People Services team** 
 , partnering with HR Operations, Payroll, Recruitment, Finance, Global Mobility, and business stakeholders across regions to deliver accurate, compliant, and efficient people services. This role is critical to ensuring operational excellence, service quality, process standardization, and scalability of ERM's global people operations model.
   

  

* What your impact is?
* Lead and develop a high\-performing People Services team that consistently delivers excellent service and achieves operational KPIs.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant processing of employee lifecycle transactions across multiple regions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance service delivery, efficiency, and employee experience.
* Maintain high levels of data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support effective workload management, SLA adherence, and resolution of escalated employee and manager queries.
* Promote collaboration across HR Operations, Recruitment, Payroll, Finance, and Global Mobility teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
* What you'll bring:
* 8\+ years of experience in HR Operations, Shared Services, People Services, or Human Resources administration, including team management experience.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong experience managing employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, contractual changes, payroll support, benefits administration, and offboarding.
* Experience working with global HR systems such as Workday, SAP HR, or similar platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to partner effectively across functions and geography.
* Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, and process management skills.
* Strong customer\-service mindset with a commitment to delivering a high\-quality employee experience.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively within service level agreements (SLAs).
* Preferred:
* Master's degree or MBA in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience working within a professional services organization.
* Exposure to global HR shared services or service centre environments.
* Experience supporting process improvement, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with ticket management platforms such as ManageEngine or similar case management tools.
* Experience working with AI\-enabled tools, workflow automation, or digital HR solutions.
* Key Responsibilities:
* Lead and manage the People Services team to ensure efficient, accurate, and timely delivery of HR administrative services.
* Monitor team workloads, service levels, and performance metrics to ensure business expectations are met.
* Provide coaching, training, and ongoing development support to People Services Administrators and team members.
* Manage escalations and support resolution of complex employee and manager queries.
* Collaborate with HR Operations teams and business stakeholders to ensure seamless global service delivery.
* Oversee ticket management activities, ensuring adherence to SLAs and appropriate prioritization of work.
* Drive process standardization, documentation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain data integrity and ensure compliance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and operational management of People Services team members.
* Contribute directly to HR transactional activities during peak periods or when additional support is required.
* In\-office during onboarding, followed by a hybrid working model (2\-3 days per week in office).

title: Sr Director Analyst (HR Strategy & Transformation)
description:
**About the role:**
 Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must\-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world\-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in\-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.
   

  

 A Senior Director possesses a keen eye for identifying gaps, problems and solutions within the market they serve. They use their knowledge to help clients make better decisions, solve complex issues and execute new practices that propel clients’ businesses toward key objectives and publish these pragmatic and/or provocative insights. Additionally, they reinforce Gartner’s value every day by engaging clients via in\-person and virtual meetings, sales support visits, Gartner conferences and industry events. This role is an opportunity to join Gartner’s growing Human Resources Practice. This group is dedicated to tracking the transformation of the HR function — evolution of the HR functional structure, HR roles, and HR technology strategy — and advising Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) and other HR functional leaders. Senior Directors are expected to offer flexibility in what they can cover and how they channel their expertise.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must\-have” insights offering compelling, objective and actionable advice for Gartner clients in multiple formats (i.e., writing, video, infographics, podcasts) on topics including (but not limited to) focusing on HR functional transformation, HR strategic planning, and HR technology strategy and use cases.
* Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act.
* Develop in\-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
* Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing insights positions across a team of analysts
* Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
* Deliver individualized advice rooted in quantitative and qualitative data and specific to a client role to CHROs and other senior HR leaders through video\-based presentations and discussions
* Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
* Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
* Provide high quality and timely content peer review
* Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
* Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
* Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
* Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
* Be client\-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions


**What you will need:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
* 12\+ years of relevant field or industry experience in HR functional and/or HR technology leadership roles or an equivalent combination of education and experience; with the below subject matter expertise:
+ Profound understanding of the challenges CHROs face as leaders within the enterprise and familiarity with the CHRO workflows and priorities
+ Experience successfully designing and leading HR functional transformations.
+ Knowledge of the HR technology landscape, including market dynamics and vendors, particularly with respect to AI, and their impact on HR strategies and workflows.

* Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
* Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
* Strong communicator who is able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
* Subject matter expert comfortable presenting at large and small\-scale speaking engagements
* Strong business and financial acumen
* Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
* Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
* Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)


**Who are we?**
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
   

  

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
   

  

 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
   

  

 Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
   

  

 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
   

  

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
 At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
   

  

 It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
   

  

**What do we offer?**
 Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
   

  

 In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
   

  

 Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.
   

  

 The policy of Gartner is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status and to seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.
   

  

 Gartner is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers, including job seekers with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career webpage as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by calling Human Resources at \+1 (203\) 964\-0096 or by sending an email to ApplicantAccommodations@gartner.com.
